frames_seen.seen: Front-step shot at dusk. A woman with a curly brown high bun, lilac pajamas with pink piping, and bare feet faces the camera and smiles. She holds a pale grey tied garbage bag in one hand. Behind her is a red front door with a round knob, a lit wall lantern on blue-grey siding, and a dark shrub. The camera is a medium-full frontal shot.

Night lawn scene. The woman walks toward the camera-right with the garbage bag hanging from one hand. She glances sideways and smiles. Behind her are a lit window with green shutters, a dark hedge, a lawn, and a fireworks burst with a bright streak in the sky. The camera is a medium shot, slightly low.

Night sidewalk scene. The woman walks with her arms at her sides, looking to her right toward a black wheelie bin. A raccoon is at the bin's open lid, with both front paws raised on its edge. The garbage bag is not visible. Behind her are houses, a hedge and a lawn. The camera is a medium-full shot.

Night street scene. The woman walks toward the camera, smiling and looking ahead, with her hands at her sides. A dark wheelie bin with a bluish lit edge sits at the right edge. Behind her are houses, a hedge and a lawn. No garbage bag is visible. The camera is a medium-full shot.

Night shot from inside a doorway. A dark red-brown door panel with hinges and a brass knob is open at the left edge, and a white door jamb with a warm light is at the right edge. The woman stands in the opening on the sidewalk, face surprised with her mouth open, hands at her sides. Behind her are the lawn, houses, and a dark wheelie bin at the right. The camera is a medium-full shot.
